mission: PHASE-26 Media Vault End-to-End Integrity Audit
head: c532201572b0ba202eb3df7fb758bb884496efea
productionBaseline: Phase 22 deployed (8804ffc / index-Cu_7jFHY.js); Phase 25 local-only (c532201) not deployed

criticalRootCause.reportedSymptom: DROP VIDEO HERE (MP4/MOV) does not respond to an MP4 drag

evidence.method: Unlock via /studio → Content tab → synthetic DataTransfer drop on [aria-label*=Video drop zone]
evidence.result: hasPending=true, hasAccept=true, zoneText shows ACCEPT/REJECT + filename
evidence.staticAnalysis: handleVaultVideoDrop → stagePendingVaultVideo only; MIME accepts video/*, .mp4/.mov, octet-stream+.mp4; placeholder pointer-events:none; vault-file-input pointer-events:none

likelyUserFacingCauses.detail: Drop never uploads. Preview/ACCEPT only. Large files (>24MB) skip blob preview — quieter UI than video preview.
VaultExperience only mounts when StudioWorkspaceLayout activeTab === 'Content'. Wrong tab = no drop zone handlers.
No document-level dragover preventDefault; drops outside zone may open file / navigate with no vault feedback.
Historical large-file signed PUT failures can be conflated with 'drop does nothing' after Accept.

pipelineMap.validation: extension+MIME in drop/file handlers; CONFIG.MAX_VIDEO_SIZE 500MB in stagePendingVaultVideo + processVaultVideoFile
pipelineMap.signedPath: shouldUseSignedVideoUpload (≥ SIGNED_UPLOADS_MIN_BYTES default 4MiB) → sign → PUT → /api/reels/finalize → poll ready
pipelineMap.multipartPath: POST /api/reels when below signed threshold and Netlify-safe
pipelineMap.catalogFeed: AI_CLEANUP_AGENT.distributeVideoToFeed after successful upload (canonical backend id)
pipelineMap.playback: Viewer/Theater consume catalog/feed reel url; Theater ownership frozen

readers: title overlay / vault projection / creator readiness
resolveUserPosterUrl / vault projection / hero poster validators

defects.title: Zero-byte videos are not rejected
defects.mechanism: Only MAX_VIDEO_SIZE upper bound is checked; size===0 accepted (live probe showed 0.0 MB pending).
defects.minimalFix: Reject file.size < 1 (or < small threshold) before staging/upload with status message.

defects.title: Dual elements share class video-vault-drop
defects.mechanism: Upload zone and delete zone both use .video-vault-drop; querySelector hits first (upload). OS files on delete forward to video drop — OK — but aria/text confusion and harness ambiguity remain.
defects.minimalFix: Rename delete zone class to video-vault-delete-drop; keep aria-labels distinct (already mostly distinct).

defects.title: Vault→feed shelf drag is not a drop target path
defects.mechanism: UI says drag media into the feed; feed shelves have no parseVaultPayload drop handlers. Insertion is auto on successful upload. Vault drag payloads serve Hero/delete primarily.
defects.minimalFix: Either document/auto-distribute-only UX copy, or add explicit shelf drop that reuses canonical id without creating a second reel.

defects.title: Studio unlock harness still depends on removed .ghost-trigger
defects.mechanism: Consumer home no longer exposes .ghost-trigger; production unlock is /studio password gate. Harnesses timeout unless updated.
defects.minimalFix: Navigate /studio, fill password, wait for control center; keep ghost as optional fallback.

defects.title: No studio-scoped document dragover preventDefault
defects.mechanism: Near-miss drops outside vault zones can trigger browser default file open with no vault feedback.
defects.minimalFix: While controlCenterOpen, document dragover/drop preventDefault without starting uploads.
